name: Springtide Storm
description:
You create a storm brimming with love an hate with the size of a 40-foot-cube centered on a point in range. Each enemy creature in the area makes a {save}. On a failed save, it takes {dice} {type} damage and has disadvantage on all attack rolls it makes until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half the damage and does not get disadvantage.

A creature also makes that save if it enters the area or ends it turn there. A creature makes that save only once per turn.
